reflection.review: Axis pivot to time-to-frontier (validator v2.2: harness-clocked anytime curves, TTF leaderboard). References: treesa-inf 20.2s/39.6s, cotengra-sa 62.7s/never. 032 set the first non-reference record on the board (reg3_250 TTF 16.1s confirmed); its sycamore arrival beats the reference on median runs but variance blocked the claim. 033 refuted its record hypothesis and delivered the pre-registered fallback: window-exact optimality certificates for both primaries.
reflection.evidence:
- attempt-032 reports 1-3: TTF runs reg3 85.4/3.7/16.1s, sycamore 49.1/12.4/81.1s; tc graze 61.467 rejected by confirmation (61.660).
- attempt-033: WINDOW-OPT certificates (reg3_250 K=16 ~86 windows, sycamore_m20 K=16 ~182 windows, zero material gains); DP validated on 400 brute-forced sub-networks.
- Scale set expanded from OMEinsumContractionOrdersBenchmark (real Sycamore 3369t, surfacecode_d21, ksg 5197t, nqueens_28); v2.3 median-of-3 live.
reflection.lessons: TTF is winnable but heavy-tailed: 20%-bar claims sit near the single-pair confirmation noise floor; target >=2x or move the gate to median-of-k arrival. Arrival time is governed by anneal schedule (linear beta, size-scaled reheats, stagnation-gated diversity), not seed quality -- DP boost inert at n>=500. Frontier trees are now triply locally optimal (O(1) rewrites, order-DP, window-exact).
reflection.next: Cycle 8 (2 rounds authorized): scale axis on expanded group -- 034 multilevel V-cycle, 035 racing portfolio, 036 deep seed + cold refine + window-exact repair; treesa-inf medians being seeded.
reflection.literature: Anytime-curve comparison at matched budgets follows [gray_2020_hyper]; harness-clocked TTF with adversarial polling appears new practice. Window-local exact optimality certificates for contraction trees not found in the KB.
